<slate title="Auth refactor" state={{ s1: false, s2: false, s3: false, s4: false, s5: false }}>
  <column id="root">
    <meter
      id="progress"
      fraction
      label="Steps done"
      value={(state.s1 ? 1 : 0) + (state.s2 ? 1 : 0) + (state.s3 ? 1 : 0) + (state.s4 ? 1 : 0) + (state.s5 ? 1 : 0)}
      max={5}
      note={`${(state.s1 ? 1 : 0) + (state.s2 ? 1 : 0) + (state.s3 ? 1 : 0) + (state.s4 ? 1 : 0) + (state.s5 ? 1 : 0)} of 5 done`}
      tone={state.s1 and state.s2 and state.s3 and state.s4 and state.s5 ? 'good' : 'default'}
    />
    <section id="steps" title="Steps">
      <column id="step-list" tight>
        <row id="step1" between>
          <text id="step1-text" tone={state.s1 ? 'good' : 'default'}>{state.s1 ? '☑' : '☐'} 1. Extract the token store</text>
          <button id="step1-tick" quiet small label={state.s1 ? 'Untick' : 'Tick'} onPress={toggle(state.s1)} />
        </row>
        <row id="step2" between>
          <text id="step2-text" tone={state.s2 ? 'good' : 'default'}>{state.s2 ? '☑' : '☐'} 2. Move session checks into middleware</text>
          <button id="step2-tick" quiet small label={state.s2 ? 'Untick' : 'Tick'} onPress={toggle(state.s2)} />
        </row>
        <row id="step3" between>
          <text id="step3-text" tone={state.s3 ? 'good' : 'default'}>{state.s3 ? '☑' : '☐'} 3. Delete the old cookie path</text>
          <button id="step3-tick" quiet small label={state.s3 ? 'Untick' : 'Tick'} onPress={toggle(state.s3)} />
        </row>
        <row id="step4" between>
          <text id="step4-text" tone={state.s4 ? 'good' : 'default'}>{state.s4 ? '☑' : '☐'} 4. Update the tests</text>
          <button id="step4-tick" quiet small label={state.s4 ? 'Untick' : 'Tick'} onPress={toggle(state.s4)} />
        </row>
        <row id="step5" between>
          <text id="step5-text" tone={state.s5 ? 'good' : 'default'}>{state.s5 ? '☑' : '☐'} 5. Write the migration note</text>
          <button id="step5-tick" quiet small label={state.s5 ? 'Untick' : 'Tick'} onPress={toggle(state.s5)} />
        </row>
      </column>
    </section>
    <button
      id="next"
      primary
      label="Go on to the next step"
      when={!(state.s1 and state.s2 and state.s3 and state.s4 and state.s5)}
      held={thread.status == 'working' ? 'The agent is still working' : null}
      note={`Next: ${!state.s1 ? 'extract the token store' : (!state.s2 ? 'move session checks into middleware' : (!state.s3 ? 'delete the old cookie path' : (!state.s4 ? 'update the tests' : 'write the migration note')))}`}
      onPress={send("Go on to the next unticked step of the auth refactor. Steps in order: 1 extract the token store, 2 move session checks into middleware, 3 delete the old cookie path, 4 update the tests, 5 write the migration note. The slate values s1 to s5 say which are ticked.", { with: [state.s1, state.s2, state.s3, state.s4, state.s5] })}
    />
    <text id="all-done" good strong when={state.s1 and state.s2 and state.s3 and state.s4 and state.s5}>All five steps are done.</text>
  </column>
</slate>
